column1: MARCUS RENEE GILES -- KINDERGARTEN TRANSITION PLANNING CHECKLIST
Prepared by: Shanice R. Giles | Prepared: January 2026 | Updated: October 2026
Marcus DOB: March 18, 2021 | Enrolling: 2026-2027 school year, assigned Hartford Public Schools elementary (kindergarten)
Note: Maple Hill Early Learning Center enrollment through last day of the 2025-2026 school year
Task
column6: Notes

column1: Research assigned kindergarten school -- location, schedule, principal contact
column6: Assigned school is 12 minutes from home. Good school; principal is someone Shanice knows from district meetings. Reassured.

column1: Confirm kindergarten enrollment eligibility (age cutoff -- Marcus turns 5 before January 1, 2026)
column6: Marcus meets the Connecticut age cutoff. Eligible for 2026-2027 kindergarten enrollment.

column1: Obtain and complete kindergarten registration packet from Hartford Public Schools
column6: Packet picked up from district enrollment office; completed and submitted February 12, 2026

column1: Gather and submit required documents: birth certificate, proof of residency, immunization records
column6: All three submitted. Used current mortgage statement for residency proof. Immunization records from Dr. Adams's office.

column1: Confirm enrollment accepted and school assignment
column6: Enrollment confirmation received by mail. Assignment confirmed. Marcus is in.

column1: Request kindergarten readiness report from Maple Hill (teacher summary for receiving school)
column6: Requested from Ms. Tanisha Warren; received February 25; kept a copy; shared with the receiving school registration packet

column1: Attend kindergarten orientation if offered by the receiving school
column6: Shanice and Marcus attended. Marcus was excited. He asked the kindergarten teacher if she liked dinosaurs. She said yes. He decided she was good.

column1: Visit the school building with Marcus before first day
column6: Walked the outside of the building with Marcus; found the main entrance; pointed out where pickup would be. He called it "big school."

column1: Purchase school supplies per kindergarten supply list
column6: List received via email from the school. Purchased at Target with Jason and Karen. Marcus chose a T-rex pencil case.

column1: Label all school supplies and clothing (iron-on labels)
column6: All supplies labeled. Mary Claire brought iron-on labels she already had. Classic Mary Claire move.

column1: Adjust Marcus's bedtime schedule for school-year sleep needs (target: 8:30 PM lights out)
column6: Started moving bedtime earlier by 15 minutes each week over the weeks before school. By the first day he was consistently at 8:30 PM.

column1: Adjust morning wake routine to prepare for earlier school start time
column6: School starts earlier than Maple Hill; practiced the wake-up and breakfast routine ahead of the first day.

column1: Coordinate pickup plan with Mary Claire for school year
column6: Mary Claire confirmed: she will pick up Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Shanice picks up Wednesday and Friday. Same pattern as Maple Hill.

column1: Confirm Mary Claire has the school's address, phone number, and emergency procedures
column6: Mary Claire has everything. Rose Delaney (at Shanice's school) also has the new school's contact in case of a school emergency while Shanice is in a meeting.

column1: Notify Maple Hill of Marcus's last day and send a thank-you to Ms. Warren
column6: Shanice wrote a personal note to Ms. Warren. Marcus made her a card with a dinosaur on it. Ms. Warren kept it on her desk.

column1: Talk to Marcus about what kindergarten will be like -- new friends, new teacher, new building
column6: Shanice read "The Kissing Hand" with Marcus twice. He decided he would hold the memory of her hand to feel brave. She did not cry until after he was asleep.

column1: Address Marcus's nervousness about not knowing anyone
column6: Shanice told him: "You learned how to make friends at Maple Hill. You already know how to do it." He said "I taught people about stegosauruses." She said "Exactly."

column1: First week check-in with teacher
column6: Shanice emailed the teacher after the first week. Teacher reported Marcus settled quickly, is talkative and kind, and has already told the class about three types of dinosaurs.

column1: Confirm school is receiving Marcus's Title I services if applicable
column6: Marcus does not qualify for Title I pull-out services; performing on grade level. Teacher reports he is doing very well. No action needed.

column1: Review first report card or progress update
column6: Progress report showed Marcus meeting all kindergarten benchmarks. Letter recognition complete. Counting to 30. Fine motor strong. Teacher note: "Marcus is a joy."

column1: Schedule parent-teacher conference at new school
column6: Conference scheduled for November 2026. Shanice put it in the calendar. She is looking forward to it.

column1: Update emergency contact form at new school (confirm Mary Claire, Jason, and Karen are listed)
column6: All three listed. Shanice delivered the form in person at registration.

column1: Ensure eczema management plan is on file with the school nurse
column6: One-page care instructions delivered to the school nurse in writing. Hydrocortisone and CeraVe details included. Nurse confirmed receipt.
